text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! The rice is piping hot~♪
It is truly, truly Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? But why is the warm,
steaming rice making you feel so gloomy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya figured it out!
It's gotta be because of all the steam~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ I see, steam~!
That is totally marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hazy, misty, water va-por~☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's a pussy willow☆
Is it a kitty? Or is it a willow?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya figured it out!
It must be a willow that's like a cat♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ You're right, just like a cat~!
Super duper marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Fluffy, fuzzy pussy willow~☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So many working adults☆
But wait, why is everyone in such a hurry?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya figured it out!
It's definitely because you work so much♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh?! That is so amazing!
Truly, truly marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Always, aaalllways, thank you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard today, and do your best~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And we're back~! This is Tracen Academy, where we run and spend our days☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, why do Umamusume run?
I wonder if there's a reason~?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, umm—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Maya gets it now!
It's because running never ends!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's no end to it~!?
Oh, right, the Earth is round!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This world is full of infinite Marvelous☆
Round and round it goes, wherever you go★

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Spinning 'round and 'round to the ends of the Earth☆
Today, tomorrow, spinning 'round and 'round☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Ahahahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Those girls have finally arrived...
—At the abyss of the world.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, kids around that age
are simply invincible, aren't they♪
